subject.title: Completar preguntas operativas de mensajeras en docs integrations

question: Which Celeritas operational source, owner/contact, and credential reference should be treated as canonical for the docs update?
rationale: The remaining facts depend on operations/vendor knowledge and secret-management policy that cannot be safely inferred from code or old Slack references.

options.title: Confirm and document canonical operations
options.body: Have the Celeritas owner or operations contact confirm the current manual, active API scope, and safe config reference, then patch the integration docs.

options.title: Split secret migration first
options.body: If the legacy credential references are still live, open a separate security/config task before publishing any stable credential-location guidance.

options.title: Close only with explicit operations decision
options.body: Close this issue only if operations confirms there is no active Celeritas contract or documentation path worth preserving.

recommendation.title: Confirm and document canonical operations
recommendation.body: Have the Celeritas owner or operations contact confirm the current manual, active API scope, and safe config reference, then patch the integration docs.

likelyOwner.reason: JavierHamelyn owns the current docs/history trail and is already assigned on the live issue.
